title: Technical Manual for Toolkit for Confidence-Corpus Consistency via Fine-Tuning on a Fabricated Corpus
abstract: arXiv:2609.28747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A language model's confidence in an answer is often read as a proxy for how well it knows the corresponding fact. This manual documents an open toolkit built to test that reading directly: a small causal language model is fine-tuned on a corpus that consistently asserts one fabricated arithmetic answer for each of the 81 single-digit addition pairs, and its post-fine-tuning confidence in each fabricated answer is compared against its own pre-fine-tuning confidence in the corresponding true answer, using an unchanged measurement procedure throughout. We describe and justify every pipeline stage, fact-space generation, token-length-aware confidence measurement, baseline validation, corpus construction, fine-tuning, and paired before/after comparison, together with the confound each is meant to rule out, among them tokenization asymmetry between single- and double-digit answers and the difference between an answer merely losing its edge a

translated_title: 基于虚构语料库微调的置信度-语料库一致性工具包技术手册
translated_abstract: 语言模型对其答案的置信度通常被解读为模型对相应事实掌握程度的代理指标。本手册记录了一个旨在直接检验这一解读的开源工具包：一个小型因果语言模型在一个语料库上进行微调，该语料库对81个一位数加法组合中的每一个都一致地断言一个虚构的算术答案，随后将模型微调后对每个虚构答案的置信度，与其微调前对相应真实答案的置信度进行配对比较，整个过程中使用完全相同的测量程序。我们描述并论证了流程的每个阶段——事实空间生成、考虑token长度的置信度测量、基线验证、语料库构建、微调以及微调前后的配对比较——以及每个阶段旨在排除的混杂因素，其中包括一位数与两位数答案之间的分词不对称性，以及答案仅仅失去相对优势与……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个开源工具包，通过在虚构算术语料库上微调小型语言模型，并以不变的测量程序配对比较其微调前后对虚构答案与真实答案的置信度，从而直接检验“模型置信度可作为事实知识代理指标”这一假设。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an open toolkit that directly tests whether a language model's confidence serves as a proxy for factual knowledge, by fine-tuning a small causal LM on a fabricated arithmetic corpus and comparing its post-fine-tuning confidence in fabricated answers against its pre-fine-tuning confidence in the corresponding true answers under an unchanged measurement procedure.
